what: the native reference: a TypeScript component the framework's own test app writes and declares in C# as an app brings a component, on the core's public surface only (its own vendor data, alis:mount); each member is named for the framework capability it exercises, and the browser tests of every core module run on it

versions.why: an older build that lacks a declared member (D4.1, X4.2)

a build that returns a promise from a method declared with Method<T> and hands a promise in a payload member declared as a value (D4.3), its drift from the declaration suppressed naming the test that arranges it (spec/CLAUDE.md, the vendor contract of 2026-11-07)

types.name: ConformanceComponent

members.ts: change: the listener's first argument, Change
commit: the listener's first argument, Change
raised: the listener's first argument, Raised
handed: the listener's first argument, the ConformancePeer it hands

types.what: the first custom component: a TypeScript object its element holds at conformanceComponent, an EventTarget heard by addEventListener and removeEventListener

types.name: ConformancePeer

members.ts: change: the listener's first argument, Change

types.what: the component ConformanceComponent's payloads hand over, on an element of its own, holding that element at element so a listen on it tells when its host destroyed it

types.name: ConformanceElement
types.what: the second custom component: the custom element conformance-element, its controls in an open shadow root, whose element is its object, declared with the platform's own vendor, ComponentVendor.Native

members.ts: opened: a CustomEvent its Open with room button dispatches with the detail { room }, and its Open with no room button with none
keydown: the KeyboardEvent its shadow root's focused key field raises, composed to the element

types.name: ConformanceRegistered
types.what: an object the conformance library keeps in a WeakMap of its own, off its element, found by the lookup the library registers as the plugin conformance-registry and heard by on and off

members.ts: threshold: number, shown beside the element
alarmed: on('alarmed', listener) calls listener with no argument when its Sound the alarm button is clicked

types.name: ConformanceStore
types.what: an object its element holds at conformanceStore, whose subscribe returns the function that removes the listener it added, and which shows the count of listeners it holds as subscribers: n

members.ts: posted: subscribe('posted', listener) calls listener(posted: Posted) when its Post an update button is clicked, and returns () => void

types.name: ConformanceCallbacks
types.what: an object its element holds at conformanceCallbacks, heard through its callback properties; its own code assigns onRaised a function that appends own to its log before any listener

members.ts: onRaised: ((raised: RaisedRoom) => void) | null, called when its Raise room 7 button is clicked
onSearch: ((query: string, show: (names: string[]) => void) => void) | null, called as its search box is typed into; show lists the names it is given under the box
the second argument, show(names: string[]): void

template.render.reason: D15.1 and D15.2 put templates in the Fusion module, where Syncfusion's engine compiles them, and give the core no template node, so a native template proves the native component's own code and no path through the framework; FusionMultiSelect's itemTemplate carries the cell

template.conditional.reason: D8.4 and D15.2 make a template conditional the Syncfusion engine's, never the core's condition, so the native reference has no engine to hold one; FusionMultiSelect's itemTemplate carries the cell
